arrays.description: sequence of ndarrays Each array must have the same shape. In the case of a single ndarray array_like input, it will be treated as a sequence of arrays; i.e., each element along the zeroth axis is treated as a separate array.

axis.description: int, optional The axis in the result array along which the input arrays are stacked.

out.description: ndarray, optional If provided, the destination to place the result. The shape must be correct, matching that of what stack would have returned if no out argument were specified.

dtype.description: str or dtype If provided, the destination array will have this dtype. Cannot be provided together with `out`.

casting.description: {'no', 'equiv', 'safe', 'same_kind', 'unsafe'}, optional Controls what kind of data casting may occur. Defaults to 'same_kind'.

output.description: ------- ndarray The stacked array has one more dimension than the input arrays.
